purpose: Teach: 艦隊/傲慢/天体/ホームレス/天下り/君が代/樹木/爆撃

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、海上自衛隊艦隊の演習を、警察、把握されてますね
lines.en: So on this matter—the Maritime Self-Defence Force fleet exercises—the police are keeping track of it, aren't they?
lines.style: Measured, slightly tentative. Pause before the specific detail. Genuinely curious but not pushing. Tone lifts slightly at the end, inviting confirmation rather than demanding it.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、容疑者の傲慢な態度を記録しております
lines.en: We're documenting the suspect's arrogant behaviour.
lines.style: Calm, official register. Direct eye contact. No inflection on the emotional word—just fact. Steady, unhurried delivery.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、天体観測サークルでの事件を、警察、捜査されてますね
lines.en: And then there's the incident at the astronomy club—the police are investigating that too, aren't they?
lines.style: Same measured pace as before. Slight tilt of genuine interest. The pattern is becoming apparent to him; he's checking his understanding without overstepping.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、ホームレス支援団体との連携を進めております
lines.en: We're also coordinating with homeless support organisations.
lines.style: Flat, informative tone. No defensiveness despite the shift in topic. States the fact with quiet competence, as if this too is expected work.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、警察OBの天下り問題を、警察、検証されてますね
lines.en: So the revolving-door issue with retired police officers—the police are looking into that as well, correct?
lines.style: Slightly more probing this time. Still respectful but with a note of subtle pressure. Waiting to see how far the officer will actually go.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、式典では君が代斉唱の警備を担当しております
lines.en: We're also responsible for security at the ceremony—the national anthem and all of that.
lines.style: Returns to pure procedural tone. No apology, no expansion. Brief, solid, moving forward. The kind of statement that closes a line of questioning.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、街路樹木の倒壊事故を、警察、調査されてますね
lines.en: There's also the matter of the street tree collapse—is the police department investigating that?
lines.style: Quieter now. The questions are becoming smaller, more local. Still curious but with less urgency. Genuine interest in how the pieces connect.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、戦中の爆撃跡地の保護も担当しております
lines.en: We handle the protection and preservation of wartime bombing sites as well.
lines.style: Softer landing. A closing statement. Weight in the voice—acknowledging something that matters, something with history. Not defensive, but gentler. He's not just reciting duties anymore.
